notes.title: Version 2.0 is here!
notes.content:
We're finally done with version 2 of Kingdom of the Dragon! Thanks so much for all of your feedback, we hope you enjoy it!

[u]Version 2.0 Changelog:[/u]

[list]
[*] Improved combat with a faster attack animation. The sword swing now feels more "instant", which improves the feel of combat

[*]A brand new island to explore just offshore from the first island. Completing this island will give you access to...

[*]A world map, with the general locations of each major upgrade in the game

[*] New "Lore Books", which will give more backstory into the world and what has happened. Find them all!

[*] The backstep move has been taken out. Not many people used it, and it was causing an exploit in the game. Now, the player simply rolls forward when either trigger button is pressed on a gamepad. 

[*] Tweaked some of the puzzles so the objective is a little more clear

[*]Improved the quality of some of the textures

[*]Moved the locations of some of the campfires

[*]Overall bug fixes and performance optimization. Delta-time will no longer be calculated below a certain framerate. This was causing some of the  physics to go crazy at lower framerates

[/list]


If you're a returning player, we recommend starting a new game (though it is not necessary). If you're new to Kingdom of the Dragon, then dive right in! 


-Jason
Hook Echo Software

[list]
[*] Improved combat with a faster attack animation. The sword swing now feels more "instant", which improves the feel of combat

[*]A brand new island to explore just offshore from the first island. Completing this island will give you access to...

[*]A world map, with the general locations of each major upgrade in the game

[*] New "Lore Books", which will give more backstory into the world and what has happened. Find them all!

[*] Tweaked some of the puzzles so the objective is a little more clear

[*]Improved the quality of some of the textures

[*]Moved the locations of some of the campfires

[*]Overall bug fixes and performance optimization. Delta-time will no longer be calculated below a certain framerate. This was causing some of the  physics to go crazy at lower framerates

[/list]

Thanks so much for all your support and feedback! We will have this update out ASAP.

-Jason
Hook Echo Software

[/list]

notes.title: Release date set! December update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we're happy to announce that we have a confirmed release date on February 2, 2018! We're putting the finishing touches on Kingdom of the Dragon, and we can't wait to let you guys play it. We're also in the process of adding Steam Achievements for you to find, and we've got some cool ones planned!

Thanks for your support, 

- Hook Echo Software

notes.title: October Update!
notes.content:
September flew by for us, and we got a ton of work done on Kingdom of the Dragon. We don't want to spoil too much, but we added some major fights and also finalized the inventory screen. The inventory system was a huge project for such a small team, and something we'd been dreading for a while. But it actually turned out way better than we thought it would, and we're really pleased with it! 

We're continuing to work hard every day to make the highest quality game we can make. If you haven't played the demo, please head over to www.hookechosoftware.com and give it a shot and share it with your friends. Thanks for your continued support!

-Hook Echo Software

notes.title: September Update!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that a playable demo of Kingdom of the Dragon is now available to play on our website! Head on over to www.hookechosoftware.com and give it a shot. You can play it right in your browser....no need to download anything. 

The demo is a very small portion of the entire game, and will introduce you to the basic gameplay mechanics. We strongly recommend using a controller, although we do offer keyboard support. There's just no better way to play an old school style side-scroller than with a controller in your hands.

We appreciate all your support, and we hope you enjoy the demo. Thank you!
